0022600205.text: The Detroit Pistons host the Washington Wizards in their 10th game of the 2026-27 season. The Pistons are 6-3, first in the Central and third in the East, but they have lost their last two games, while the Wizards are 4-6, eighth in the East and on a three-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet this season, and Detroit won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 117-95 win in Washington on March 19, 2026. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision.
